verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Secure Data Sharing lets accounts share live database objects with other Snowflake accounts (and via Data Marketplace/organizations) without copying or transferring data, explicitly stated in docs ('no actual data is copied or transferred between accounts'), and is included even at the entry Standard pricing tier. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of cross-organization sharing UX and any documented limitations/edge cases beyond vendor docs.
